planned.scene: Aoi arrives at her grandmother's gate above a mountain village in Nagano.
On the veranda, Aoi holds a bamboo lantern hoop steady while her grandmother pastes a thin sheet of washi paper over a tear; several simple round lanterns rest nearby.
At the wooden gate at dusk, Aoi and Ren face Kohaku, a small boy in a fox mask with one black-tipped ear and a red cord without a bell; Aoi holds the repaired lantern as he asks them to come help.
